long_biography.plain_text:
Prestipino advanced from sales and field operations at Versyss and Softdesk to worldwide information-technology leadership at Autodesk. As president and chief executive of Scribe Software, he directed a turnaround and growth programme before moving into venture evaluation at Borealis Ventures.

At Envista, Prestipino became chief executive of a web-based mapping software company serving utilities and municipal agencies. Envista was acquired by Accela after developing its right-of-way management platform. Prestipino subsequently served as chief operating officer of cloud-software provider IndependenceIT. He now manages The MFO Group, a New Hampshire investment-management business, and is identified publicly as chief executive of MFO Capital.
